title: Studio Poster Series
subtitle: An illustrated poster set for a concert season
description: A set of bold, illustrative posters announcing a concert hall's seasonal programme.
problem: The venue's promotion looked tired and failed to convey the energy of its live programme.
process: Developed an illustration language per genre, then unified it under one typographic system.
solution: A vivid, cohesive poster series that travels from street to social while feeling unmistakably one venue.
